contents.content:
Bagmane Tech Park is one of the primary IT hubs in Bangalore and draws many professionals from all walks of life. Some global companies here include Dell, Oracle, and Cognizant. In this space, you would easily get a decent place to stay near Bagmane Tech Park to elevate your quality of life significantly. This article highlights the best places to stay near Bagmane Tech Park with features that make them unique, as well as their current packages and rental prices.

Key Takeaways

Convenience: Having the office near Bagmane Tech Park saves time when commuting.
Diverse Options: There are various neighborhoods for all budgets and lifestyles.
Amenities: Comfort would be improved by access to schools, hospitals, and shopping centers
Rental Prices: Average rents help budget rental prices.

Factors Influencing Housing Choices

Some of the locational factors that may guide your choice while searching for accommodation near Bagmane Tech Park include:

Proximity to Employment

It is good to stay close to work. It saves some time and the money that was going to be spent on commuting. For example, many people are moving into areas like Indiranagar and Mahadevapura, which are at such a short driving distance to the Bagmane Tech Park.

Availability of Amenities

The second concern is access to necessary facilities. School, hospitals, shopping malls, and so on in the neighborhood make people look forward to it. For instance, the locality Kaggadasapura offers a number of facilities that make life convenient day to day.

Best Areas to Stay Near Bagmane Tech Park

Here are some of the best neighborhoods near Bagmane Tech Park:

1.CV Raman Nagar

It is situated in the eastern part of the city. Bagmane Tech Park is within a kilometer distance from the locality. The locality is bounded by Indira Nagar, Kaggadasapura and Baiyappanahalli. The locality is named after the scientist C. V. Raman of Bangalore. Some of the best schools located in the area include Kendra vidyalaya, Orchids International Schools, and Global City International Schools. One of the oldest Bangalore malls, Gopalan Mall  is also situated here. There are a lot of multispecialty and super specialty hospitals easily accessible from this place. The area is pretty huge and has plenty of supermarkets.

Distance From Bagmane Tech Park-1.4 Km

2.Domlur

Domlur is a small township towards the eastern part of Bangalore. About 3 km from Bagmane Tech Park, a lot of other multinational software companies like Intel, NetApp, Dell, IBM, Microsoft, etc. are also based in Domlur. It also has the software park Embassy Golf Links (EGL). The locality is quite secure as a couple of military establishments have sub-divisions in the locality. The connectivity through the bus is really good. It has a few good schools in the vicinity as well. It is only 2.5 km from Indiranagar which offers a happening lifestyle and attracts young crowd. Sri Sai Specialty hospital and Command Hospital are among the best hospitals in the area. It has plenty of super markets around.

Distance From Bagmane Tech Park-5.9Km

Mahadevapura is one of the most exciting new communities of this city. Due to the heavy investment done in infrastructure, it now houses several commercial enterprises such as IT, retail, and food service.

Some of the other places to be visited are Bannerghatta National Park, Cubbon Park, and Lalbagh Botanical Gardens that can easily be reached on day trips from Mahadevapura. Choices like National Museum of Natural History and Karnataka Folk Museum provide options for the museum-going enthusiasts in Bangalore. If you are seeking a place to live around Bagmane tech park, Mahadevapura would top your list.

Distance From Bagmane Tech Park-6km

Kaggadasapura, is a nice residential locality and has many apartment complexes. Apart from being close to the tech park it is also a 15 minute drive from Indira Nagar, one of the most happening areas in Bangalore. Some of the important research establishments such as Defence Avionics Research Establishment (DARE), Centre for Artificial Intelligence Research (CAIR) and DRDO Phase II are located in Kaggadasapura. There are good schools in the neighborhood such as Global City International School, Geethanjali Vidyalaya and Sishya BEML. It also includes several multispecialty hospitals within the locality. This locality allows easy connectivity to KR Puram Railway Station. In fact, this happens to be one of the oldest localities of Bangalore, and there are many libraries for adults & children in this locality.

Distance From Bagmane Tech Park-5.6km

5.Indiranagar

Bagmane Technological Park is close to Indiranagar, which is one of the city's most happening areas. House for rent in Indiranagar is available and the public transport in the city makes it all the more easy for tourists to move about. And the area's nightlife is happening!

The neighborhood of Bangalore's Bagmane tech park is steeped in tourist destinations. The nearby parks and gardens include Indiranagar Park, Cubbon Park, and Lalbagh Botanical Garden.

For instance, there is the Bangalore Fort, which delights history lovers, and a goer for shopping can walk along the MG Road or Commercial Street, get a feel of local culture in the Venkatappa Art Gallery, or the Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath.

Distance From Bagmane Tech Park-4.5km

6. Marathahalli

Marathahalli is an upwardly mobile area of Bangalore since it lies close to the Bagmane Technology Park. From this area, one can travel any place of the city, and public transportation is available for all modes of travel. The quality of houses on rent in Marathahalli is exceptional, with schools and hospitals around this area, so it's a good place to start and extend a family.

Besides, bus excursions can be availed for day excursions from Marathahalli to places like Bannerghatta National Park, Shivaganga Falls, Nandi Hills, and Skandagiri. With a very cheap cost of living, Marathahalli is one of the best options for people working in Bangalore's Bagmane tech park.

Distance From Bagmane Tech Park-7.6km

All these neighborhoods will appeal to you when you decide to look for housing near Bagmane Tech Park in Bangalore, considering all the advantages, yet affordability while working in the tech park and nearby places. It is the best place which is convenient as well as cost-effective for professionals to settle down in Bangalore.
